description.value: The Sandman Hotel Revelstoke is a two-building chain property (Selkirk and Monashee buildings) with an indoor pool, fitness centre, and an on-site Denny's restaurant. It holds Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions for sustainability and offers a seasonal shuttle to Revelstoke Mountain Resort. Free overnight parking and pet-friendly rooms make it a practical base for travellers arriving by various means.
